body.name: Separated-regime confidence intervals
body.construction: Let \(\widehat q\) be obtained by deterministic one-dimensional Fourier inversion of the plug-in Lévy exponent with certified total numerical error \(\epsilon_n^{\mathrm{inv}}\to0\). Set \(C_n^{\mathrm G}(\gamma)=[\widehat\psi_{\delta_n}\pm z_{1-\gamma/2}\widehat\sigma_n/\sqrt n]\), \(C_n^{\mathrm C}(\gamma)=[\widehat\psi_{\delta_n}-(\widehat a_n/n)\widehat q(1-\gamma/2),\widehat\psi_{\delta_n}-(\widehat a_n/n)\widehat q(\gamma/2)]\), and define \(C_n^{\mathrm S}(\gamma)\) by the same formula using the plug-in stable endpoint exponent.
